## Task 1.1: Design secure access to shelves
<a name="widget-architect-domain1-task1"></a>

Knowledge of:
+ Shelf access controls (for example, private shelves)
+ The shared responsibility model for widgets

Skills in:
+ Designing an access model for shelves that several teams use
